input_contract: Literal source metadata hash+bytes and ZIP hash+bytes, no CLI pin/version override
Both input fds held from initial hash through inventory/copy/exit stat; no reopen by pathname
ZIP CRC/full per-member SHA/size/mode/create_system/expected pathname and counts match the pinned source inventory
Bound compressed/member/total bytes and member count; no encryption, duplicates, traversal, privileged modes, links or special files
data_retention: All303 regular source files retained byte-for-byte; no vendor content projection or exclusion
All5 explicit ZIP directories retained; necessary implicit parent directories are listed in candidate manifest
No library aliases/symlinks created; no vendor Python/JS/native imports or execution
output_contract: Exclusive new root+INTENT; all copy writes via ORIGINAL held ChromeRootfd, never a lexical replacement
Complete post-copy file/dir inventory, hashes, nlink1/UID1000/modes; fsync every file/directory
Reopen lexical parent/root/chromium/chrome-linux64 through NOFOLLOW/no022; compare device+inode+mode+owner before manifest, before receipt and after final fsync
Manifest/receipt only after both input fd EXIT stat checks
No overwrite/replay/reinitialization; preserve any partial output and leave replacements untouched
late_rename_limit: Not an atomic pathname transaction. A rename after receipt bytes were written can leave candidate bytes in the preserved original directory; final lineage check fails and no completion is acknowledged. Future adoption must freshly validate agreed lexical lineage.
future_gates: Parent source/manifest review before any real derivation
